title: Nikkei surpasses 70,000 points for first time in three months driven by Wall Street gains
summary: The Japanese index recovers the 70,000-point level after a drop in expectations of U.S. rate hikes and buying of technology stocks.

title: Brazil heads to runoff election between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula da Silva
summary: The son of former president Bolsonaro leads the first round with nearly 47% of the vote, against 45% for incumbent Lula.

title: Japan closes Asian Games with record 83 golds and seventh consecutive softball title
summary: The Japanese delegation achieves its best-ever gold medal tally, highlighting dominance in softball and the emergence of young talents.

title: U.S. withdraws B-1 bombers from British base over Iranian attack threat
summary: The Pentagon orders the departure of aircraft from Fairford base after detecting an alleged Iranian plan to attack Western interests.

title: Houthis attack Riyadh with missiles and drones as Yemen launches large-scale offensive
summary: Houthi rebels strike Saudi Aramco oil facilities and the Saudi-backed Yemeni government declares a major military operation.

title: Trial begins for deadly Kitakyushu fire; defendant denies charges
summary: The former building resident denies any connection to the fire that caused six deaths, while the defense alleges lack of direct evidence.

title: Dodgers lose to Braves in divisional series; Ohtani still homerless in 94 at-bats
summary: Los Angeles falls 1-1 in the series after Sasaki's performance and an Ohtani hit, but the offense fails to rally.

title: Okinawa protests after arrest of U.S. Marine for murder of Japanese woman
summary: The governor and citizens demand revision of the Status of Forces Agreement after the discovery of a woman's body in a hotel and the arrest of a 20-year-old soldier.

title: Prudential receives external commission report and will hold press conference on October 8
summary: The insurer will announce the results of the independent investigation into its internal practices.

title: Nikkei suffers cyberattack with 9,000 spoofed emails sent to contacts and sources
summary: Attackers used compromised accounts to send fraudulent emails and possibly leak personal information.
